source: https://pzwiki.net/wiki/Admin_commands (page note: last edited for 42.17.0; verify with /help on your build)
notes: In-game chat needs a leading slash; server console and RCON do not.
Command names below are the bare console/RCON form.
Some wiki table labels differ from the real command name (e.g. kick → kickuser).

commands.name: players
commands.description: List all currently connected players.

commands.name: kickuser
commands.description: Kick a player from the server. Optional reason with -r.

commands.name: banuser
commands.description: Ban a player by username. Add -ip to also ban the IP, -r for a reason.

commands.name: banid
commands.description: Ban a SteamID.

commands.name: banip
commands.description: Ban an IP address.

commands.name: unbanuser
commands.description: Remove a username ban.

commands.name: unbanid
commands.description: Unban a SteamID.

commands.name: unbanip
commands.description: Unban an IP address.

commands.name: setaccesslevel
commands.description: Set staff access level: admin, moderator, overseer, gm, observer, or none.

commands.name: grantadmin
commands.description: Grant full admin access to a player. Prefer setaccesslevel for explicit tiers.

commands.name: removeadmin
commands.description: Remove admin access from a player. Prefer setaccesslevel "PlayerName" "none".

commands.name: voiceban
commands.description: Mute or unmute a player's voice chat (-true / -false).

commands.name: godmode
commands.description: Toggle invincibility. Without a username, applies to yourself.

commands.name: godmodeplayer
commands.description: Toggle invincibility for another player.

commands.name: invisible
commands.description: Toggle invisibility to zombies. Without a username, applies to yourself.

commands.name: invisibleplayer
commands.description: Toggle invisibility to zombies for another player.

commands.name: noclip
commands.description: Toggle walking through walls/structures for a player.

commands.name: teleport
commands.description: Teleport yourself to a player, or teleport player1 to player2.

commands.name: teleportplayer
commands.description: Teleport one player to another player.

commands.name: teleportto
commands.description: Teleport to world coordinates x,y,z.

commands.name: adduser
commands.description: Add a user to the whitelist with a password.

commands.name: removeuserfromwhitelist
commands.description: Remove a user from the whitelist.

commands.name: setpassword
commands.description: Change a user's password.

commands.name: addsteamid
commands.description: Allow a SteamID on the server allow-list.

commands.name: removesteamid
commands.description: Remove a SteamID from the server allow-list.

commands.name: additem
commands.description: Give an item to a player (or yourself if no username). Count is optional.

commands.name: removeitem
commands.description: Remove items from yourself. Count 0 removes all of that type.

commands.name: addvehicle
commands.description: Spawn a vehicle near a player or at coordinates.

commands.name: addxp
commands.description: Give skill XP. Wiki format uses perkname=amount (skill IDs can differ by build).

commands.name: addkey
commands.description: Give a key to a player (or yourself). Key name is optional.

commands.name: createhorde
commands.description: Spawn a zombie horde near a player. Username required from console/RCON.

commands.name: chopper
commands.description: Trigger a helicopter event on a random player.

commands.name: gunshot
commands.description: Place a gunshot sound event on a random player.

commands.name: removezombies
commands.description: Remove zombies (server help text may vary by build).

commands.name: worldgen
commands.description: Control the full world generator: start, recheck, stop, or status.

commands.name: alarm
commands.description: Sound a building alarm at the admin's position (must be in a room).

commands.name: startrain
commands.description: Start rain. Optional intensity 1–100.

commands.name: stoprain
commands.description: Stop raining on the server.

commands.name: stopweather
commands.description: Stop current weather effects on the server.

commands.name: startstorm
commands.description: Start a storm. Optional duration in game hours.

commands.name: lightning
commands.description: Trigger lightning near a player. Username required from console/RCON.

commands.name: thunder
commands.description: Trigger thunder near a player. Username required from console/RCON.

commands.name: save
commands.description: Save the current world immediately.

commands.name: quit
commands.description: Save and shut down the server.

commands.name: servermsg
commands.description: Broadcast a chat message to all connected players.

commands.name: showoptions
commands.description: Show current server options and values.

commands.name: changeoption
commands.description: Change a live server option.

commands.name: reloadoptions
commands.description: Reload server options and send them to clients.

commands.name: reloadlua
commands.description: Reload a Lua script on the server by filename.

commands.name: reloadalllua
commands.description: Reload all Lua scripts on the server. Use carefully on live worlds.

commands.name: releasesafehouse
commands.description: Release a safehouse you own.

commands.name: checkModsNeedUpdate
commands.description: Check whether installed mods need an update (writes to log).

commands.name: log
commands.description: Set server log level for a log type (e.g. General, Network, Lua).

commands.name: stats
commands.description: Set or clear server statistics output (none/file/console/all).

commands.name: removemapsymbolsforuser
commands.description: Remove all shared map symbols for a specific user.

commands.name: help
commands.description: List all commands, or show help for one command.
